ATTEND is a reproducible multi-omic QC and analysis pipeline built with
[workflowr](https://workflowr.github.io/workflowr/) and
[renv](https://rstudio.github.io/renv/).

- **R 4.3.2**, **Bioconductor 3.18** (pinned in `renv.lock`).
- Restore the environment with `renv::restore()` before building.

See `CLAUDE.md` in the repository root for the architecture and command reference.
